Messages.Author: drnlmza
Messages.Body:
The old text on Dabbler on the Black Chantry reprints

> Dabbler wrote:
> One each turn after resolution of an action during which this vampire used 3 or more disciplines
>
Latest text on Dabbler

> Dabbler wrote:
> Once each turn, this vampire can gain 1 blood or burn 1 blood to unlock after performing an action (successful or not) during which they used 3 or more Disciplines to play cards.
>
"Performing an action" looks like a huge functional change from "during an action", since it's no longer possible to trigger Dabbler while reacting.

a) Why was this errata made?

b) Why was it not announced?

--
National Coordinator
South Africa

Messages.Author: drnlmza
Messages.Body:
Just noting that the new wording of Dabbler is quite similar to the updated text for Perfectionist, so this may also be an unintended change from trying to unify the wording of the two cards.

Either way, some clarification on this would be appreciated.

--
National Coordinator
South Africa
